content: Passionate software developer proficient in Python, Java, C++, and full-stack development. With multiple national level hackathon wins, competitive programming achievements, and hands-on projects in AI, backend, and web applications, I excel in both collaborative team settings and independent problem- solving.
Bachelor of Engineering in Information Technology, Vasavi College of Engineering CGPA: 8.06 | SGPA (Sem 5): 8.67

CuraFusion, 2nd Prize - Hackathon by IIT Hyderabad Developed a real-time patient monitoring platform that auto-assigns doctors and delivers AI-based triage support. Utilizing Kafka and REST APIs, we stream patient vitals every five seconds, applied Pathway for alert detection, and integrated the Gemini API to provide AI-generated first-response instructions until the doctor arrives. Tools Used: Python, Kafka, Pathway, Gemini API, REST APIs, Streamlit.

Power Grid Load Balancing Simulator, 1st Prize - Demux 2.0 Hackathon Built a large-scale simulator to optimize electricity distribution using flow networks and min-cost max- flow algorithms. Modeled dynamic city demands, renewable energy intermittency, and probabilistic line failures to generate cost-efficient dispatch plans with blackout avoidance and overload prevention. Tools Used: Python, NetworkX
1st Winner Demux 2.0 National Level Hackathon by BVRIT
